title: bake signed artifact index and provenance into private-installer release manifests
author: Maya Kline
description: Motivation: private deployments (VPC/on-prem) require a reproducible, signed index that bundles release artifacts (installer tarballs, Helm charts, Terraform modules), attestations (SBOM/prov.json), and signature metadata so customers can verify what they deploy. This PR introduces a baked 'signed-artifact-index' generation step in the private-installer release pipeline, integrates Notary v2-compatible signing (via GCP KMS in CI), surfaces provenance files alongside Helm and Terraform artifacts, and wires the installer/upgrade tooling to consume the index during installs and rollbacks. Implementation summary: 1) CI: add .github/workflows/release-private-installer-index.yml that builds artifacts in a hermetic container, generates SBOMs (syft), produces provenance JSON, and invokes notary-v2 client to produce signatures and an OCI index blob that contains pointers to signed artifacts; 2) release manifests: produce release-manifests/private/<version>/signed-artifact-index.json (index is content-addressed and references OCI descriptors for artifacts plus prov and sbom); 3) installer: private-installer/installer/manifest_fetcher.go updated to fetch and verify the signed index using a configurable verification key/cert bundle; 4) helm & terraform: helm-charts/values.yaml and terraform/modules/private_release/main.tf updated to prefer signed artifacts when index is present; 5) upgrade/rollback tooling: upgrade-planer now reads index history to plan deterministic rollbacks. Checklist: - [x] CI job builds artifacts and SBOMs - [x] Notary v2 signing step implemented with KMS key reference (kept configurable per org) - [x] Signed index JSON schema and example added - [x] Installer verification path implemented and tested locally - [x] Terraform module fallback added when index absent - [x] Documentation and upgrade notes drafted (docs/private-release-index.md) Notes on security: private key material is never stored in the repo; CI uses ephemeral signing via KMS grant. For air-gapped/private builds, the index generator supports an 'offline-sign' mode where prov + sbom are exported for customer-side signing. Rollout plan: land on main behind feature flag RELEASE_SIGNED_INDEX, enable on canary private release, collect verified installs, then flip default for new releases. Related: follows up on ENG-4920 and ties into SUP-3212 customer request for verifiable artifacts. Release notes: see release_notes field.

release_notes: Add signed-artifact-index to private releases: release manifest now includes a content-addressed index with SBOMs and provenance; CI produces Notary v2-compatible signatures via configured KMS. Installer and Terraform/Helm modules can verify signatures and prefer signed artifacts. Operators can use offline sign mode for air-gapped environments.
notes_for_followup: Automate rotation of KMS signing keys and add staged key promotion in the release pipeline (ENG-5120)
Consider support for TUF metadata layer on top of the index for higher resilience
Metrics: add gauge for index verification latency and histogram for index size
